method.description: Decode exact ordinal RGB frames. Subtract alpha-zero scene-start background; measure caption-region differences and positive white-glyph geometry. Compare normalized transformed settled-glyph field with measured early glyph field, fitting amplitude independently so a fade-only fallback cannot satisfy a motion test.

limitations: This is native pipeline recognition/visible-motion proof for the exact static-background fixture, not a general optical-flow test or a physical-device/Android runtime-export proof.

The export must have zero initial PTS, 720x1280 dimensions and24fps. The immutable fixture hash/title contracts are enforced; unexpected metadata or dynamic control backgrounds fail rather than silently weakening thresholds.

White-glyph contrast and normalized transform correlation suppress compression noise, dark caption-box opacity and global alpha changes. Background gradients underneath a moved caption can still reduce correlation; raw differences alone never count as motion recognition.

Exact curve equality across JS/Swift/Kotlin is established separately by animation-parity.json; compressed frame fits establish geometry consistent with those IDs, not exact floating-point equality or full entry/exit-curve coverage.
Primary samples are frame3(.125s) versus frame12(.5s), except pulse frame6(.25s) versus12; extra samples and duplicate fixture scenes are reported as corroboration.
